thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - GPU queue growth detected in eu-west-1. autoscaler reported 'max_node_count' reached for gpu-nodepool-prod. queue length ~ 1.8k, service latency spike.

maya (on-call): seeing it. queue up from ~200 to 1800 in the last 6m. pods Pending with reason: Insufficient nodes — autoscaler hit max.

aj (sre): confirm. metrics: token-generation p95 → 2.3s -> 12.4s. error budget alarms firing.

incident-bot: Pager -> SRE on-call, paging escalation threshold met.

maya (on-call): tagging @katie infra and @emma eng-runtime. Is there a quick way to temporarily raise nodepool max while we triage? We need to avoid customer timeouts. :pray:

katie (infra): I can do a manual cap bump but need approval from infra rotation lead. @emma can you state expected delta and rollback plan?

emma (eng-runtime): workload footprint shows ~6 extra nodes would stabilize queue under current traffic. We should keep quantization and batching disabled for safety while we scale. Will push a safe fallback route to send new jobs to a cheaper region if we hit a second ceiling.

maya (on-call): ok; request: +6 nodes to gpu-nodepool-prod (current max 40 -> 46). ben (customer-success) pls flag any high-priority customers.

ben (customer-success): Notified top-tier customers; few are seeing timeouts. One customer reported a job failure (ticket #CS-9203). I'll keep them updated.

aj (sre): runbook step: `manual nodepool cap raise`. Confirming we'll also pause large-batch offline jobs to free immediate capacity.

emma (eng-runtime): pausing offline batch now: `kubectl annotate batch/job nightly-compress ops/pause=true` (applied).

katie (infra): requesting infra-lead approval via SSO. ETA 3-5m.

ops-bot: approval granted by infra-lead @sam at 12:14 UTC.

katie (infra): performing manual cap bump in cloud console now. Command I will run:
```
# terraform-ish equivalent - doing a manual override in console
cloudctl nodepools update gpu-nodepool-prod --max-nodes 46
```

katie (infra): done. Cloud autoscaler refreshed. new upper bound 46. Cluster started provisioning new nodes. ETA ~4m.

maya (on-call): seeing pods scheduling, kube events show nodes Registered, kubelet Ready.

aj (sre): watching queue. drop from 1.8k -> 300 in next 6m. p95 latency improving.

product-support: routing deferred requests to secondary fallback while capacity stabilizes. temporary rate-limit window applied to non-paid tiers.

ben (customer-success): primary affected customer updated: recovery in progress. They want a postmortem and SLA credit request template when resolved.

emma (eng-runtime): next steps: 1) revert manual cap after traffic normalizes, 2) investigate why autoscaler didn't request nodes earlier (scale policy hysteresis?), 3) add alert for queue growth vs max_node_count threshold. I'll open runbook PR.

aj (sre): initial hypothesis: aggressive PDBs on controller pods + long node provisioning times triggered backlog; autoscaler logic delayed due to bursty request pattern.

maya (on-call): handoff: I'm going offline in 30m. @aj you'll take lead for triage and postmortem. Confirmed that manual bump restored service.

aj (sre): taking it. I'll file an incident ticket and attach logs (kube events, autoscaler diagnostics, node provisioning traces).

ops-bot: Incident status update: mitigated -> service recovery observed. Root cause investigation pending.

maya (on-call): thanks team. final notes: keep the manual upper bound documented in the incident ticket and include the exact console steps katie used. action owners: emma -> runtime fix; aj -> postmortem; katie -> infra play docs; ben -> CS comms template.

aj (sre): opened INC-2026 with attachments. assigning owners. ETA for postmortem draft 48h.

ben (customer-success): will prepare SLA credit template.

product-support: leaving rate-limit window in place for another 10m to be safe.

maya (on-call): resolved for now. handing off to @aj (sre). cc @katie @emma. :white_check_mark:

aj (sre): acknowledged. starting thorough RCA.

-- thread closed but follow-ups will be tracked in INC-2026 --
